batch_tokens.title: Batch token budget
batch_tokens.summary: Sets the approximate token budget for processing one batch.
batch_tokens.description: Controls how much candidate material is grouped for a model-based processing step.

item_characters.title: Item character budget
item_characters.summary: Limits the text retained for each candidate item.
item_characters.description: Truncates candidate descriptions supplied to the filtering step when they exceed the configured character budget.
